lmsConfig.driveSizeHint: Each user default cloud drive size; teachers get multiplied by the multiplier

lmsConfig.ojUrlHint: Base URL of the Online Judge used by OJ questions; leave empty to disable OJ fetching
lmsConfig.codeflowUrlHint: URL of the online runner opened when clicking Run on a Python code block; leave empty to use the built-in default
lmsConfig.danmakuHint: Control whether students' submissions broadcast danmaku to the class channel (server-side WS).
lmsConfig.enableDanmakuHint: When off, no danmaku (user-sent or auto on submission) is broadcast.
lmsConfig.studentCanSendHint: When off, regular users cannot send danmaku; only teachers receive it.
lmsConfig.enableOnQuestionHint: Broadcast a danmaku to the class channel when a student submits a question.
lmsConfig.enableOnHomeworkHint: Broadcast a danmaku to the class channel when a student submits a homework.
lmsConfig.enableOnQuizHint: Broadcast a danmaku to the class channel when a student submits a quiz.
lmsConfig.enableOnCommentHint: Broadcast a danmaku to the class channel when a student publishes a comment.
lmsConfig.questionOnlyOnCorrect: Question danmaku only on correct answer
lmsConfig.questionOnlyOnCorrectHint: Skip the danmaku broadcast when the student answers a question incorrectly.
lmsConfig.onlyOnReward: Skip danmaku when no exp awarded
lmsConfig.onlyOnRewardHint: Skip the danmaku broadcast when the submission yields zero experience (over submit limit, retake a passed quiz, etc.).
